_doc: Submarine telecommunications cables, OpenStreetMap seamark:type=cable_submarine (© OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL) — power-tagged ways excluded. RAW overlay, no ladder gating. Coverage is real everywhere cables exist but OSM mapping completeness is heavily skewed to Europe/NE-Atlantic; sparse rendering elsewhere reflects mapping completeness, not an absence of cables. Compiled by scripts/submarine_cables_build.py. Global reference for scale: TeleGeography's public submarine cable map (resources.telegeography.com), publicly cited as over 1.5 million km of cable in service, early 2026.

secondary.reason: Verified live this session: location=underwater+communication minus the primary tag and power-tagged ways = 18 ways globally (0.24% of primary) — confirmed by an exact Overpass count, not estimated, but too small to justify wiring in for v1. A larger unverified candidate (submarine=yes minus primary, 1,297 ways) is filed as a follow-up in research/open_questions.md, not shipped without a live tag-quality check.
